storage: HDF5 with Robomimic data/demo_N episode groups
episode_boundary: one simulator reset and one complete recording
control_frame_semantics: The workstation samples robot and patient state after applying the control command stored on that frame.

transition_alignment.reward: zero_unqualified_reward[i+1]; mechanics deltas are diagnostic until action-bound same-step target batching exists
transition_alignment.done: termination_or_truncation[i+1], with the final stored transition marked as an episode boundary

action.semantics: six relative Cartesian IK values and one gripper command per PSM

observations.joint_pos: all PSM joint positions in registered articulation order
observations.joint_vel: all PSM joint velocities in registered articulation order
observations.tool_positions_w: world-frame tool positions with a separate validity mask
observations.target_relative_tool_positions: authored compression target minus each world-frame tool position
observations.sensor_authority: whether a real post-physics jaw sensor pair was available
observations.selected_arm: one-hot arm selected by local contact evidence
observations.room: optional endoscope RGB using only the latest frame at or before control time
observations.room_valid: zero when no causal frame exists or the selected frame is a sensor dropout
